note: Spring Park area of Lake McConaughy SRA, off Hwy 92 near Lemoyne on the north shore: a small, remote grass-site loop in a wooded draw above the lake, some sites tent-only, primitive restroom, few amenities; water at nearby Cedar View. Normal drive-in sites, not beach camping. The lake is low and its shore now lies well below the campground (NGPC 2026: public ramp access gone with declining water levels). --Claude
summary: Still NGPC. 14 Basic grass sites, no water, FCFS even in peak season confirmed from NGPC's McConaughy page (Aug 2026 capture). Season and fees left. PIN is ~2.1 km off, in the lake: move to the loop. Waterfront lakefront -> lakeview (weak). Sand rule: grass sites on a gravel loop, fine.
flags: PIN MOVE: stored 41.27770,-101.85360 is in the lake ~2.1 km ESE of the campground. Move to 41.28856,-101.87472 (the Spring Park loop and its restroom on NAIP; Google's 'Spring Park Campground' point is 41.28856,-101.87457). elevation_meters will need refreshing with the move.

WATERFRONT lakefront -> lakeview (down; weak, and could go to not waterfront). At the true location the loop sits in a wooded draw, and a treeline plus the access road down the draw lie between the sites and the beach, which rules out on-water. Even measured to the beach/high-water edge rather than today's drawn-down waterline, that edge is ~80-150 m away behind the trees, and open water is ~600 m south across exposed lakebed sand. The view: the draw opens south toward a ~30,000-acre lake, so a view from the loop's south side is plausible but not confirmed (no site photos). If a site photo shows no lake, not waterfront.

SAND (AWH 2026-11-05 clarification): Spring Park is NOT bare-beach camping. NGPC: 'this area features grass sites'; imagery shows a gravel loop on grass off the paved Hwy 92 entrance road. Fine for EKKO, no drop. The old note's beach-camping and 4WD lines describe McConaughy's separate Shoreline Road / Cedar View beach camping areas, which are not this entry.
PHONE missing on the entry: 308-284-8800 (NGPC page and 2025 grid, Google); apply.py doesn't write phone.

SEASON year_round true left as derived (note prose): NGPC says all McConaughy camping is FCFS Sept 11 - May 19 and Spring Park 'will remain' FCFS, but doesn't say in so many words that the loop is open year-round.

NOTE: dropped '~14 Basic drive-in sites', 'no water on site', 'FCFS year-round here (most of McConaughy is reservation-only May 20-Sep 10)' (fields), 'Park entry permit required' (fees.entrance), and 'Sandy beach camping; soft-sand beach driving elsewhere needs 4WD ... beach camping permit applies' (not this campground: NGPC describes Spring Park as grass sites, and beach camping is in separate designated areas).
